title: Document native platesolver architecture, index generation and distribution
description: Owner request (2026-11-20): create indigo_drivers/agent_platesolver/doc/PLATESOLVER.md as a comprehensive English technical reference for the internal plate solver and index generator. Explain component responsibilities and data flow; image decoding/preprocessing and star detection; image quad construction and invariant codes; staged index search, hints and matching; consistency checks, rejection and solution verification; WCS fitting and reported coordinates, scale, rotation, parity and residuals; limits, aborts, caching and memory use. Give the corresponding end-to-end index-generation pipeline, catalogue acquisition/input formats and proper motion, sky sampling and quad selection, index construction and output. Migrate all relevant material from indigo_docs/SOLVER_INDEX_FORMAT.md, preserving format details and attribution; retire that old document at the end of consolidation and update relevant incoming links. Document reproducible index build commands, filenames and scales, GitHub repository/release/assets used for distribution, how to replace/update indexes and how to add new catalogues/scales, including required source/configuration touchpoints and compatibility considerations. Inspect current source and verify live GitHub release details; distinguish implemented behavior from guidance. Documentation-only scope: no solver, generator or index asset changes and no publication. Validation: check technical claims and examples against implementation, migrated-content completeness, local Markdown links/anchors and stale references to the retired path; run configured checks applicable to documentation. Use the existing correct agent_platesolver directory; the spelling in the requested shorthand path is treated as a typo.

Read the complete new reference and retired format reference; compared detector/filter thresholds, canonical quad geometry, staged search/hints/voting, robust affine fit and output formulas, loader/writer validation, catalogue parsers/proper motion, exact sampling tiers, ownership/compaction, download/update/cache behavior, CLI syntax and Makefile targets with source. All relevant old format tables, conventions, size/working-set example and author/coauthor attribution are preserved, with useful implementation qualifications. Reviewed README/HOME/Xcode relocation and seven asset sizes/URLs against the saved public API response verified on 2026-11-20. Recorded whitespace/link/anchor/plutil validation is appropriate to this documentation-only tree. Coverage limits: static source/documentation review, not a full solver audit; no builds, runtime tests, catalogue or binary asset downloads, index generation or publication performed.
